output.headline: Anthropic's listing closes; the $26.0 billion side placement is the part to read carefully
output.lead: Anthropic closed its initial public offering, receiving approximately $91.6 billion, and sold approximately $26.0 billion of a separate share class to seven technology companies; the announcements do not say what those shares confer. A month earlier it cut government prices 40% with no minimum spend. Both developments come from the company's own releases, and this edition treats them that way.
